answer.text: Funds provided in hybrid structure involving features of both debt and equity

explanation.text: The Logic: Mezzanine capital combines debt and equity features — hybrid investment structure. The Trap: Pure debt/equity classifications don't capture mezzanine. Cross-Exam Context: Important alternative capital structure. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Mezzanine investments often have warrants/conversion — evaluate dilution carefully.
